alt: Animated: three starting points advancing in step across the complex plane — one escaping fast, one bounded, one lingering near the boundary — with a |z|-versus-step chart alongside.
caption: Three orbits under the same rule, stepping together. One is past |z| = 2 within a few steps and gone for good, one stays bounded forever, and one hangs near the boundary for dozens of steps before it commits. The step where a track crosses the line on the chart is that orbit's escape time — the whole of what the picture is painted from.

alt: The Mandelbrot set with its real and imaginary axes marked and four colored rings on it, each ring's Julia set below in a frame of the same color — a solid blob from deep inside, filigree from the boundary, disconnected dust from outside.
caption: The Mandelbrot set read as an atlas of Julia sets. Each ring marks one value of c, and the Julia set that value draws is the panel below wearing the same color. A c from deep inside gives a solid, rounded blob; a c from outside shatters into dust; a c from the boundary unfurls its neighborhood's spirals and filaments across the whole frame. The blob-versus-dust split is not a matter of degree — a Julia set is connected exactly when its c lies in the Mandelbrot set.

The c values themselves are not printed on the sheet.
